title: Airbnb Booking Weekly Stay Nights Trend
dataSources: Airbnb bookings (`airbnb:booking`), Vrbo reservations (`vrbo:reservation`), Airbnb payouts (`airbnb:payout`), and guest reviews (`guest:review`).
app: Airbnb booking exports, Vrbo reservation webhooks, Airbnb payout statements, guest review logs, and turnover checklists streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airbnb:booking stay_nights=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(stay_nights) as avg_duration, max(stay_nights) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst stay nights for Airbnb booking events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture stay_nights on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average stay nights with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether Airbnb booking tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
